description: Bowed, and took the cousin's part without a speech.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Pinned the sleeve at the elbow.
name: Edith Kettlewood

description: Left the dice and the apples, and stayed in the door without speaking.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Asked whether Burbage means the parts he is putting on.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Held the crown, and held still.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Held the roll, afraid of his six lines.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Not called. Not in the rehearsal.
name: Will Kemp

description: Played, and brought no part-name away.
name: William Shakespeare
